contentText:
Anker’s 45W charger is less than $50 during Amazon’s October sale. In fact, you can get two for under $50.

Getting in on the Prime Day action doesn’t have to result in an empty wallet. Just as we found a couple handfuls of goodies that are under $25 , there are plenty of deals during Amazon’s October sale that are $50 or less, many of which offer a lot of practical value. Everything from chargers to coffee makers are discounted until 3 AM ET on October 8th, 2026, so you only have a few hours to take advantage of some of these deals.

For the full range of deals, make sure to head over to our main roundup , where we’ll keep updating prices and stock into the evening.

LEGO Star Wars The Mandalorian’s N-1 Starfighter

This 412-piece set features the Mandalorian’s reconstructed Naboo starfighter, with minifigs for Din Djarin, Grogu, and Peli Motto.

Where to Buy:

- $59.99 $41.99 at Amazon

VidaBay NFC E-Paper Fridge Magnet

A tiny magnetic digital photo frame that repurposes a color E Ink screen developed for use as electronic shelf labels.

- $29.99 at Amazon

- $35.99 $30.99 at VidaBay

- $99.99 $88.99 at VidaBay (three-pack)

EasySMX S10

The EasySMX S10 is our favorite Switch 2 controller for people who don’t want to spend twice as much on Nintendo’s option. It offers an excellent take on HD rumble, along with amiibo support and the ability to wake the Switch remotely.

- $59.99 $39.89 at Amazon (black)

- $59.99 at EasySMX

- $59.99 $44.99 at Amazon (white, for Prime members)

Ridge Tracker Card

This incredibly slim tracking card is just 1.55 millimeters thick, compatible with both iOS and Android, and recharges wirelessly via MagSafe or Qi.

- $39 $32.99 at Amazon

HOTO Electric Screwdriver Rechargeable

Hoto’s compact rechargeable electric screwdriver includes 12 magnetic tips. It’s great for quick fixes at home or on the go.

- $59.99 $37.99 at Amazon

TP-Link Tapo Matter-Certified Smart Plug Mini

A smart plug adds functionality to an existing gadget rather than replacing it. Once the plug is connected to your Wi-Fi network and a gadget, you can turn it on and off using an app. TP-Link’s Tapo smart plug supports Matter, so you can add it to whichever smart home platform you use.

- $19.99 $7.99 at Amazon

Anker Nano 45W charger with display

Anker’s latest single-port USB-C charger offers up to 45W of power, foldable prongs, and a front-facing “smart display” that lets you see the charge level, power flow, and other useful information at a glance.

- $39.99 $23.99 at Amazon

- $39.99 $25.99 at Anker

Blink Outdoor 4 and Battery Doorbell 2K+

This Blink bundle includes the battery-powered video doorbell with a 2K resolution, and an outdoor camera.

- $149.98 $27.99 at Amazon

Loop Quiet 2 earplugs

Attending a live concert? You can protect your hearing with Loop’s Quiet 2 earplugs. They pack up to 24dB (SNR) of noise reduction and come with four eartip sizes, allowing them to accommodate a range of ear shapes.

- $24.95 $19.95 at Amazon

- $24.95 at Loop

Amazon Echo Dot (Fifth-Gen)

Amazon’s Echo Dot is an affordable way to add a smart speaker to your space. The small, powerful speaker offers surprisingly robust sound, and it’s great for controlling smart home devices, including those compatible with Matter. The Dot also offers faster response times than its predecessor, and it can act as an extender for an Eero Wi-Fi system. Read our review .

- $79.99 $39.99 at Amazon

- $79.99 $39.99 at Best Buy

- $79.99 $39.99 at Target

Amazon Fire TV Stick 4K Max (2023)

Amazon’s Fire TV Stick 4K Max is noticeably faster than its predecessor, features Wi-Fi 6E, and benefits from twice the storage. It can also showcase widgets and artwork when idle, and continues to offer robust Alexa integration.

- $59.99 $44.99 at Amazon

- $59.99 $44.99 at Best Buy

- $59.99 $44.99 at Target

JBL Go 4

The last-gen JBL Go 4 has been around for a bit, but the pocket-sized Bluetooth speaker still delivers with up to seven hours of runtime, dual device connectivity, and an IP67 rating for water and dust resistance. You can also pair it with other Go 4 speakers for bigger stereo sound, if desired.

- $49.95 $34.95 at Amazon

Life360 Tile Tracker

The Tile can help you keep track of your personal belongings from up to 350 feet away, which is 100 feet more than its predecessor. The handy location tracker is also platform-agnostic and can send SOS alerts, though only if you pay for Life360’s Gold subscription ($14.99 a month).

- $24.99 $19 at Amazon

Anker Zolo MagSafe power bank (10,000mAh, Qi 7.5W)

This compact 10,000mAh power bank is MagSafe compatible, with both 7.5W wireless and 30W wired charging over USB-C.

- $49.99 $34.99 at Amazon

Black & Decker Dustbuster

Black & Decker’s handheld vacuum can help you quickly clean up small messes in your home or car.

- $59.99 $42.43 at Amazon

LifeStraw personal water filter

LifeStraw’s basic filter removes unwanted bacteria and microplastics as you drink, giving you a safe way to hydrate no matter where you are.

- $17.95 $12.98 at Amazon

Ring Solar Panel (2nd Generation)

The Ring Solar panel can keep your outdoor cameras or other small devices charged up with up to 4 watts of power via USB-C.

- $59.99 $47.99 at Amazon

Goodr OG Sunglasses

Goodr’s classic OG sunglasses have polarized lenses and come in a variety of stylish colors. They’re cheap, durable, and practical.

- $29.99 $24 at Amazon

Keurig K-Express

The compact Keurig K-Express brews single cups of K-Cup coffee pods, with a 48 ounce reservoir for fewer refills.

- $109.99 $49.99 at Amazon

Pokémon Legends: Z-A

Pokémon Legends: Z-A is the first game in the main series with a real-time battling system instead of the traditional turn-based formula. Its more action-oriented battles and smooth performance on the Nintendo Switch 2 are very welcome.

- $69 $39.99 at Amazon (Switch 2)
